$comment: The Honeycomb Alpha yoke, same shape as bravo-buttons.json: 'controls' is the PHYSICAL map (which button number each control is - measured by tools/Probe-HoneycombDevices.ps1 -Capture data/alpha-buttons.json, never typed in), 'map' is what each control does in the sim. 'device' tells the capture which unit to read. Every control starts unverified; the capture asks for each in turn, S skips one the yoke does not have. Labels are written for the person holding the yoke. Numbering is FSUIPC's: prober minus 1, and above 31 plus 100. Latching = a switch or rotary position that stays put; momentary = springs back.

YOKE_LEFT_TOP.label: LEFT horn: the upper push button under your thumb

YOKE_LEFT_BOTTOM.label: LEFT horn: the lower push button under your thumb

YOKE_RIGHT_TOP.label: RIGHT horn: the upper push button under your thumb

YOKE_RIGHT_BOTTOM.label: RIGHT horn: the lower push button under your thumb

TRIGGER.label: the trigger on the back of the LEFT horn (push-to-talk)

HAT_UP.label: hat switch pushed UP (straight up, not diagonal)

ROCKER_LEFT_UP.label: LEFT horn: the two-way rocker pushed UP (toward the top of the horn)

ROCKER_LEFT_DOWN.label: LEFT horn: the two-way rocker pushed DOWN

ROCKER_RIGHT_UP.label: RIGHT horn: the two-way rocker pushed UP

ROCKER_RIGHT_DOWN.label: RIGHT horn: the two-way rocker pushed DOWN

SW_BAT.label: base: MASTER switch, the BAT half, flipped ON (up) - flip it OFF first if it is on

SW_ALT.label: base: MASTER switch, the ALT half, flipped ON (up)

SW_BEACON.label: base: BCN light switch flipped ON (up)

SW_LAND.label: base: LAND light switch flipped ON (up)

SW_TAXI.label: base: TAXI light switch flipped ON (up)

SW_NAV.label: base: NAV light switch flipped ON (up)

SW_STROBE.label: base: STROBE light switch flipped ON (up)

MAG_OFF.label: base: ignition key turned to OFF (turn it to R first if it is already OFF)

MAG_R.label: base: ignition key turned to R

MAG_L.label: base: ignition key turned to L

MAG_BOTH.label: base: ignition key turned to BOTH

MAG_START.label: base: ignition key turned and HELD at START, then let it spring back

map.$comment: Empty on purpose. What each Alpha control does is Mark's decision (see notes/alpha-plan.md), taken after the physical map is measured. Same shape as the Bravo's map: press / release / when, controls as FSUIPC numbers or preset names.
